overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structural MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, or histomolecular data. The IDH call is the most uncertain because age and mild enhancement favor IDH-mutant disease, while necrosis, edema, mass effect, and ependymal/deep invasion are aggressive features. Tissue diagnosis with IDH testing, ATRX/p53, TERT, 1p/19q, and CDKN2A/B status remains required.
